name: API Showcase
description: Interactive showcase of every SuperOne mini-app API, with live demos and React + vanilla JS code samples

tools.name: show_message
tools.description: Display a message banner inside the open API Showcase panel. Use this to demonstrate a panel-bound tool whose handler lives in the running React app.

text.description: The message text to display in the panel

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.description: Propose an action the user must confirm in an inline UI before it runs. The agent provides an action label and optional detail; the user approves or edits it in the confirm card, then a receipt is rendered inline.

action.description: Short label of the action to confirm

detail.description: Optional extra detail shown to the user

tools.name: bump_counter
tools.description: Increment a persistent counter and render the result as a self-contained card inline in chat. Works even when the app panel is closed (standalone tool).

by.description: Amount to add to the counter (default 1)
